exposure: maternal BMI categories: normal (BMI <24.9), overweight (BMI 25-29.9), obese class I (BMI 30-34.9), and obese class II (BMI 35-39.9)
outcome: absent or reversed end diastolic flow
cohort: 1074 singleton pregnancies with suspected fetal growth restriction on ultrasound examination between 24+0 and 36+0 weeks of pregnancy
finding: There is a positive correlation between increasing maternal BMI and abnormal UA Doppler findings in pregnancies complicated by FGR.
birth_weight: Lower birthweights were associated with higher maternal BMI
